notes.title: Demo Update: UI & Visuals Revamped!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Players!

In this demo update, we've rolled out multiple visual and interface optimizations, aligning with the official version's UI to enhance your gaming experience! Here are the key highlights:

1. Home Screen Upgrade:

Revamped visuals for a sleeker look! Smoother navigation and eye-catching aesthetics.

2. Dialogue Experience Enhanced:

Redesigned dialogue interface for better readability and clearer storytelling.

3. NEW Feature: CG Gallery!

Relive stunning game moments anytime in the all-new CG Gallery!

4. Character Art Updates:

Optimized illustrations for two highly-discussed characters—subtle but impactful tweaks now live!

Jump back in and try the new updates~

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Drop your feedback in the comments—your insights fuel our progress!

Happy Gaming! (≧∇≦)ﾉ
